# Jared Furtado

> Jared Furtado is a Computer Engineering student at Goa College of Engineering (2024–2028) in Goa, India, and is still early in learning. He has practised with React, Next.js and Node.js through personal projects, two client websites and eight hackathons, and is learning DevOps (Docker, GitHub Actions, Terraform and Kubernetes) through the 100xDevs cohort and small projects of his own.

Website: https://jaredfurtado.tech/
Email: jaredfurtadowork@gmail.com
Location: Goa, India

## DevOps learning projects (in progress)
- [Beacon](https://github.com/jjf2009/Beacon): A deploy-aware monitoring and incident platform, run with Docker Compose. Early stage; built to learn observability.
- [Cless-TUI](https://github.com/jjf2009/Cless-TUI): A terminal chess game against a bot, built module by module as a deliberate way to practise Go, testing, Docker, CI/CD, Terraform and Kubernetes.
- [PairUp](https://github.com/jjf2009/PairUp): A collaborative interview platform. Early stage.
- [Runbox](https://github.com/jjf2009/Runbox): A sandboxed code-execution engine. Early stage.
- [ReviewPilot](https://github.com/jjf2009/ReviewPilot): An AI code-review GitHub App. Early stage.

## Selected projects
- [InvestorFinder](https://github.com/jjf2009/InvestorFinder): A free, automated weekly scraper that collects Indian startup funding data from public sources, filters for EdTech deals and cross-references investors against the SEBI AIF registry. Runs on a scheduled GitHub Actions workflow with no server, writing results to public CSVs.
- [Latex-Service](https://github.com/jjf2009/Latex-Service): An Express.js microservice with a REST API that compiles LaTeX source to PDF. Fully Dockerized as a single stateless container.
- [secure-image-encryption-aes-256-gcm](https://github.com/jjf2009/secure-image-encryption-aes-256-gcm): Encrypts images client-side with AES-256-GCM via the Web Crypto API, so no plaintext or key touches a server. Runs entirely in the browser.
- [broken-link-audit](https://github.com/jjf2009/broken-link-audit): A free CLI crawler that scans any site for broken links, images and media with no URL cap, reporting issues by parent page. Includes an automated test suite.
- [RideBuddy](https://github.com/jjf2009/RideBuddy): Student carpooling with a React frontend, Node/Express backend and Firebase authentication, merged into one monorepo. Containerising and deploying it is next.

## Other projects
- [ScrapCo](https://github.com/jjf2009/ScrapCo): Scrap material trading platform (frontend + backend monorepo)
- [IntentOS](https://github.com/jjf2009/IntentOS): AI-driven intent interface
- [CampusHearts](https://github.com/jjf2009/CampusHearts)
- [AnnaData](https://github.com/jjf2009/AnnaData-Smart-Farm-Management-Portal): Smart farm management portal
- [litmus](https://github.com/jjf2009/litmus-milk-adulteration-detector): Real-time milk adulteration detection

## Client work (freelance, Dec 2025 – Aug 2026)
- [Global Tourist Centre](https://globaltouristcentre.com/): Moved a tourism company's website to Next.js and added German, French, Russian and Italian versions. Stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, i18n.
- [Techjeeva](https://findfund.vercel.app/): Funding-discovery platform for FIIRE Forum (Forum for Innovation, Incubation, Research and Entrepreneurship) listing Indian government funding schemes for startups, filterable by sector and eligibility. Source: https://github.com/jjf2009/Techjeeva-
